evidence: Across 10 timetable versions, all 300 route-query results matched a full scan. Revisions changed 4,223 destination arrival labels; checkpoint repair visited 1,969,278 connections versus 8,903,454 for full recomputation.
next_decision: Retain prefix checkpoints only while their input prefix is unchanged. Early-in-day edits can erase the savings; invariance against full routing remains the release criterion.
boundary: The archive assigns each download a non-overlapping archive interval. This is a comparison of overlapping planned calendar service inside those files. Results concern scheduled travel in a selected network, with a stated same-station transfer buffer and no street-walking links.
